_usage: Copy this template into the target project's chosen config directory and adjust project.root, which is resolved relative to the copied config file. This generic template deliberately uses manual backends; after workspace discovery, replace only the relevant backend sections with mpcli, J-Link, OpenOCD, pyOCD, DFU, vendor CLI, serial, RTT, relay, or other project-specific adapters.

flash.instructions: Replace after discovering the target's actual flash tool and artifact. Do not inherit mpcli assumptions into another platform.

reset.instructions: Record reset/power/download-mode wiring and polarity before automating any electrical action.

capture.instructions: Replace with serial/RTT/SWO/network/file capture after discovery.
